title: Job
description: A piece of work the pipeline does to one asset: ingest it, read it, index it. The job is the record of the attempt — when it started, when it stopped, and what went wrong — never the work's output, which belongs to the asset it was done to.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

asset.description: The asset being worked on, as the system that owns the asset names it. A job without one is not a job: there is nothing to process.

status.description: Where the attempt got to. A closed vocabulary because the pipeline branches on it, and the same one the asset carries.

errorMessage.description: What went wrong, as the worker reported it. Read by a person deciding whether to retry; never parsed.

startedAt.description: When a worker picked it up, which is not when it was queued. Absent while it waits.

finishedAt.description: When it stopped, whether it succeeded or failed. Absent while it runs.
